summary: One request planned into six tasks and run across five agent CLIs by the packaged Windows 1.2.2 candidate, then reviewed, refused once as stale, refreshed and applied.
host: Windows 11 development host; MSI extracted with msiexec /a, isolated Pytxo state, trust store and WebView2 profile; the project folder chosen through the real Windows folder dialog
fixture: docs/demo/fleet (task board app; request in docs/demo/fleet/mission.txt at the time of the run)

stale_refusal.cause: an untracked operator-note.txt was added to the project after the review was prepared

limits: OpenCode and Antigravity exited 0 with passing task checks but changed no files. OpenCode could not reach its model because workers do not receive host environment keys; Antigravity's headless mode denied a command and stopped. Both causes were addressed after this run and have not yet been re-run natively.
One run on one development host; not a speed, cost or code-quality comparison with running the same agents directly.
The candidate was unsigned and run from an extracted payload; clean installation and signed updates are verified separately.
Host filesystem and network controls were advisory in this Orbit run; Apply wrote only the seven reviewed files.
